remarks: 11.6 Acre Shovel-ready Building Lot in North Amherst. Shovel-ready building lot in North Amherst offers 11.6 acres of space with a partially wooded setting. You will get the feel of country living in the Williamsville School district while still being minutes to 990 and UB, along with shopping and parks. The 1,360-foot deep lot has been permitted by the NY DEC and the US Army Corps of Engineers. The property backs to 460 feet of frontage on Ransom Creek, creating a wonderful backdrop for kayaking and time outdoors. Enjoy a peaceful stroll through the natural surroundings. Near the road entrance, there is a 25' by 50' sturdy barn, plus a gravel parking area. Water, electric, and natural gas are available at the street. Septic plan has been approved. Appointments are required to walk the property.
